h1: What kind of AI assistant fit does your site need?
lede: Use your approximate monthly question volume and number of domains to get a starting point before you compare plans.
body:
This is a directional calculator, not a quote or a recommendation. It uses published SiteMind plan boundaries; a real conversation can consume several answered questions.

Your starting point

Count answers, not visitors. Use support history if you have it.
Include separate sites or subdomains you want one workspace to cover.
Your rough fit

Starter boundary

Enter your details to see the closest published capacity boundary.

Test SiteMind free ↗

This referral link may earn me a commission if you subscribe, at no extra cost to you. Verify current pricing and fit on the official pricing page.

Starter

One domain and up to 1,000 published monthly credits. A sensible pilot when your question volume is modest.

Growth

Up to five domains and 5,000 published monthly credits, plus analytics, webhooks, and actions.

Pro

Up to ten domains and 20,000 published monthly credits for higher-volume support.

Boundaries checked against SiteMind pricing and SiteMind features. Provider terms can change.
